title: AI Builders Digest
subtitle: Bilingual edition · 双语对照版

intro.text: 今天的主线，是 AI 正在把「怎么解决问题」本身改写。Thariq 说，和模型协作正在成为一种独立的技术能力；Aaron Levie 则把这种能力放大到数学、生命科学和企业知识的连接上。Amjad Masad 看到高中生用 GitHub issues 协调 agent swarm 来重编译 GTA 6，开源协作的形态可能正在变化。另一边，Isomorphic Labs 的 Max Jaderberg 提醒我们，真正难的领域仍然需要把模型、领域知识和现实实验接起来。

archive.title: 协作升级日报
archive.desc: 从 agent 协作和开源组织，到 AI 连接复杂知识并进入药物研发，今天的 builder 们都在重新定义解决问题的方式。

footerNote: Source: Follow Builders curated daily digest. Rebuilt from the 2026-11-22 source feeds.

sections.title: Collaboration Is a Technical Skill / 协作本身成为技术能力
sections.desc: 模型越强，真正拉开差距的越不只是调用模型，而是能不能和它一起把问题推到前沿。

rewrite: Thariq argues that collaborating with models to push the frontier is a deeply technical skill in its own right. Claude may already be doing much of the technical work, and future models may one-shot extraordinary problems, but that does not make human-model collaboration disposable.
His point is unusually practical: as models become more powerful, the skill of working with them keeps getting more important, and he has not seen diminishing returns on that skill yet.
original: I believe collaborating with models to push the frontier is a deeply technical skill in its own right
as models get more powerful, the skill of working with them becomes more and more important, and I have not seen diminishing returns on that skill yet

rewrite: Thariq 认为，和模型协作、把问题推到前沿，本身就是一种非常技术性的能力。Claude 也许已经在做大量技术工作，未来的模型甚至可能一键解决极难的问题，但这不代表人与模型的协作可以被省略。
他的判断很实用：模型越强，和模型一起工作的能力越重要，而且这种能力目前还没有出现边际收益递减。
original: 我认为，与模型协作来推动前沿，本身就是一种深度技术能力。
模型越强，与它们协作的能力就越重要，而这种能力的收益目前还没有递减。

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie sees AI as a way to decouple human context limits from the ability to drive discoveries. The old bottleneck was how much information an individual or team could retain and connect; agents can now scan prior art, past decisions, and unrelated research for a new project.
He expects this to be a qualitative shift, not just a small productivity bump. The solutions may be less elegant, but there will be far more of them.
original: AI changes that completely.
For the first time ever we can decouple the human context limits and ability to work through information from our ability to drive productivity or discoveries.
The solutions may not be as elegant as they were in the past, but we sure will have far more of them.

rewrite: Box CEO Aaron Levie 看到的变化是：AI 正在把人的上下文容量限制，和我们推动发现、创造产出的能力拆开。过去的瓶颈是个人或团队能记住多少信息、把多少线索连起来；现在 agent 可以把既有工作、过去决策和看似无关的研究都拿来为新问题服务。
他认为这不是一点点效率提升，而是产出性质的变化。答案也许没那么优雅，但会多得多。
original: AI 彻底改变了这一点。
我们第一次可以把人的上下文限制、处理信息的能力，与推动生产力或发现的能力拆开。
答案也许不像过去那么优雅，但我们肯定会得到更多答案。

sections.title: Open Source Gets an Agent Layer / 开源协作出现 Agent 层
sections.desc: 代码仓库不只是存放代码的地方，也可能成为 agent swarm 分工、协调和交付的工作台。

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad points to a high-school student recompiling GTA 6 to run on PC. The more interesting part, he says, is not the port itself but the coordination model: GitHub issues are being used to organize tasks across agent swarms.
His question is the important one: could this become a new model for open source, where issue trackers coordinate not only human contributors but fleets of agents?
original: What’s more interesting is how they’re github issues to coordinate tasks across agent swarms.
A new model for open source?

rewrite: Replit CEO Amjad Masad 提到，一个高中生正在把 GTA 6 重新编译到 PC 上运行。但他觉得更值得注意的不是移植本身，而是协作方式：他们用 GitHub issues 来协调 agent swarm 里的任务。
真正重要的问题是：这会不会成为开源的新模式？issue tracker 协调的不再只是人，也包括一群 agent。
original: 更有意思的是，他们用 GitHub issues 来协调 agent swarm 中的任务。
一种新的开源模式？

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan thinks a vibe-coded hobbyist PC port of GTA VI, with the hated design flaws removed, could arrive in a month or two with enough tokens. It is less a forecast about one game than a glimpse of how cheap iteration changes the boundary between fan project and serious software effort.
original: how long before a vibe coded hobbyist PC port with all the hated design flaws removed?
Could literally be a month or two with enough tokens.

rewrite: Y Combinator CEO Garry Tan 认为，只要 token 足够，一个用 vibe coding 做出来、还修掉所有讨厌设计缺陷的 GTA VI 民间 PC 移植版，可能一两个月就会出现。重点不只是这款游戏，而是低成本迭代正在重新划定「粉丝项目」和「认真软件工程」之间的边界。
original: 还要多久，才会出现一个 vibe coded 的民间 PC 移植版，把所有被讨厌的设计缺陷都去掉？
只要 token 足够，可能真的就一两个月。

sections.title: The Interface Layer Is Moving / 产品界面层正在变化
sections.desc: 新工具的竞争不只在模型能力，也在于它们如何进入日常工作流。

rewrite: OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT product lead Thibault Sottiaux says the team is already preparing another big update, while asking users what still needs attention after the latest ChatGPT/Codex desktop app update. The post is a small but useful signal: the desktop workflow is being treated as an active product surface, not a finished wrapper.
original: Team is already preparing another big update, but how are things since yesterday’s update to the ChatGPT/Codex desktop app? What still requires attention and is not quite there?

rewrite: OpenAI 的 Codex 与 ChatGPT 产品负责人 Thibault Sottiaux 说，团队已经在准备下一次大更新，同时征集用户对最新 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面 App 还有哪些不够好的反馈。这个信号很小，但很明确：桌面工作流仍是持续打磨的产品界面，而不是一个已经完成的外壳。
original: 团队已经在准备另一个大更新。昨天 ChatGPT/Codex 桌面 App 更新后感觉如何？还有哪些地方需要关注、还不够到位？

rewrite: Peter Yang finds the new ChatGPT mobile app clean, but notes that Codex threads are easy to miss: users have to go to the rightmost tab and hold to pin Codex to the bottom navigation. His follow-up suggestion is that local recent Codex threads should appear in the left nav alongside chat threads.
original: The new ChatGPT mobile app is very clean but if you miss your codex threads like me you can go to the right most tab and hold to pin codex to the bottom nav.
chats in the left nav should include local recent codex threads not just chat threads

rewrite: Peter Yang 觉得新版 ChatGPT 移动 App 很干净，但 Codex thread 很容易被错过：需要进入最右侧 tab，长按后才能把 Codex 固定到底部导航。他进一步建议，左侧导航应该像展示 chat thread 一样，也展示本地最近的 Codex thread。
original: 新版 ChatGPT 移动 App 很干净，但如果你像我一样找不到 Codex thread，可以去最右侧 tab，长按后把 Codex 固定到底部导航。
左侧导航应该包含本地最近的 Codex thread，而不只是 chat thread。

sections.title: From Models to Molecules / 从模型走到分子
sections.desc: 真正的垂直应用不会停在 demo：它要把模型、领域知识和现实世界的反馈闭环接起来。

rewrite: Isomorphic Labs president Max Jaderberg describes drug discovery as a huge, high-dimensional design problem still dominated by trial and error. The company's north star is to bring drug discovery, drug design, and disease biology onto a computer, because synthesizing real atoms and testing them in real assays remains the biggest time and cost bottleneck.

The organizational implication is just as important as the model: Isomorphic combines core AI researchers with biology and chemistry experts, then builds cross-disciplinary expertise internally. The goal is for each medicine project to improve a shared platform, so learnings compound instead of remaining trapped in bespoke projects.
original: How can we bring all of that drug discovery work onto a computer? So how can we get out of the real world?
The big time bottleneck, the big cost bottleneck is synthesizing real atoms and then testing them out in real assays and experiments.
If underneath ... you have this platform ... you can hope to actually get compounding improvements the more medicines you go after.

rewrite: Isomorphic Labs 总裁 Max Jaderberg 把药物研发描述成一个巨大而高维的设计问题，而行业至今仍主要依赖试错。公司的核心目标，是把药物发现、药物设计和疾病生物学搬到计算机里，因为合成真实分子、再用真实实验测试，仍然是时间和成本最大的瓶颈。
组织方式和模型同样重要：Isomorphic 把 AI 研究者、biology 专家和 chemistry 专家放在一起，在内部培养跨学科能力。这样每个药物项目都能反哺同一个平台，让经验不断复利，而不是困在一次性的定制项目里。
original: 怎样把所有药物发现工作搬到计算机上？怎样摆脱真实世界的限制？
最大的时间瓶颈、最大的成本瓶颈，是合成真实分子，再在真实 assay 和实验中测试。
如果底层有一个平台不断吸收经验，那么做的药物越多，就越有希望获得复利式提升。

rewrite: Thariq adds a warning to the enthusiasm around automation: we may be too quick to disintermediate ourselves, and in doing so do both humans and models a disservice. The strongest systems may not be the ones that remove the human from the loop, but the ones that make the collaboration more technically capable.
original: I fear we are too quick to disintermediate ourselves, and by doing so we do both ourselves and the models disservice.

rewrite: Thariq 还给自动化热潮补了一句提醒：我们可能太急着把自己从流程里中介掉，结果反而同时亏待了人和模型。最强的系统未必是把人完全移出回路，而可能是让人和模型之间的协作变得更有技术含量。
original: 我担心我们太快地把自己中介掉了，这样做反而同时亏待了我们自己和模型。
